pull:
**Pull request #3970 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #3970: Patch: the private lobby keeps Ready and Start in view on a phone and at 1280×720, for 1v1, co-op and 2v2

Closes #3954

The lobby's Leave, Ready and (for the host) Start now sit in one sticky bar at the bottom, in view without scrolling at all seven `MENU_SIZES` and in 1v1, co-op and 2v2. The "Ready to queue" check mark now has a gap before the words.

## What changed
- **Action bar:** `.lobby__actions` in `lobby.css` is now a sticky bar. It sits at `bottom: max(var(--shell-bottom, 0px), env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))`, so a phone's tab bar and the bottom inset stay clear of it. It has an opaque background and a brass top border, and the seats scroll behind it.
- **Ready moved into the bar:** `LobbyScreen.tsx` draws an empty slot in the footer between Leave and Start, for members only. `YourDeck` takes a `readySlot` prop and portals its Ready button into that slot. The Verdict stays beside the deck picker.
- **Check mark gap:** `.lobby .lobby-verdict[data-ready="true"]` in `routes/lobby.css` is now a flex row with an 8px gap. A new `.lobby .lobby-verdict__mark` rule gives it the same sizing as the `/play` one. The `/play` rules are more specific and unchanged.
- **Ruling:** R3954000 is in `spec/rulings/R3954000.md` with its paragraph in `spec/pending/3954.md`. `R3730001.md` gets one "Amended by" line.

## Decisions
- **Sticky bar over compact seat cards.** The 2v2 phone page overflows by 278 px, and compact seats alone would not recover that. One rule fixes every format and size.
- **Rejected a `position: fixed` bar.** It ignores the shell's `--shell-bottom` offset and would cover the tab bar.
- **Portal over lifting Ready's state.** Ready's pick, validator and run state stay inside `YourDeck`, and only the button's place on screen moves.
- **`DeckEditor.tsx` untouched.** Its "Ready to queue" is a heading with no check mark.
- **Plan followed:** I made no departures from it.

## Testing
- **`cargo jackioh spec check`:** ok (2185 rulings).
- **`vitest run src/lobby src/routes/play.test.tsx`:** 5 files, 104 tests passed, including the new `R3954000` jsdom test.
- **`pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`:** clean, after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`.
- **`eslint` on `apps/web/src/lobby` and the cypress spec:** clean.
- **`cargo fmt --check`:** clean.
- **`cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`:** printed `classify: Internal`.
- **Cypress, `lobby-screen.cy.tsx`:** all 63 passed.
  - **New coverage:** for each of the 4 lobby kinds at each of the 7 sizes, it checks that Ready, Leave and (for the host) Start are inside the viewport, above the real tab bar, and not covered. There is also a check-mark gap test at each size.
  - **Fails without the fix:** with `position: sticky` swapped for `static`, 6 failed and 57 passed.
- **Not run:** the full harness suite, including the cargo workspace tests and clippy.

## For the reviewer
- **Viewport height:** Cypress ran the taller sizes (820×1180 and others) at a viewport only 720 px high. The bar is checked within that.
- **Tab order:** Ready now follows the seats and invites in Tab order, matching where it sits on screen.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-8`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 10.0 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 148s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1795s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 581s |

</details>

Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.

The builder's notes when it stopped ````markdown # Plan (sonnet, medium) ## Goal In the private lobby, at all seven `MENU_SIZES` and in 1v1, co-op and 2v2, the player's Ready and the host's Start (with Leave) are in view without scrolling. They sit above the phone tab bar and the bottom safe area, and the seats scroll beneath them. The check mark in "✓ Ready to queue" gets a space after it. **Choice, with the reason (ruling R3954000):** one sticky action bar at the foot of the lobby, not compact seat cards. On a phone the 2v2 page overflows by 278 px, which compact seats alone would not recover, and a bar fixes every format and size with one rule. Ready is today inside `YourDeck`, in the side column below the deck picker. So the bar is `.lobby__actions`, and `YourDeck` portals its Ready button into a slot in that footer. The "Ready to queue" gap lives only in the lobby's `.lobby-verdict` CSS: the `QueuePanel` Verdict has a bare ✓ span, and `.lobby .lobby-verdict` has no flex or gap, unlike `.tavern.play-screen`'s. `DeckEditor.tsx`'s "Ready to queue" is an `h3` with no check mark, so it needs no change. ## Files to touch | File | | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx` | change | A `readySlot` state in the lobby component. A slot element in the footer. `YourDeck` takes a `readySlot` prop and portals its Ready button into it. | | `apps/web/src/lobby/lobby.css` | change | `.lobby__actions` becomes a sticky bar. `.lobby__ready-slot { display: contents }`. | | `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css` | change | `.lobby .lobby-verdict[data-ready="true"]` becomes a flex row with a gap, plus `.lobby .lobby-verdict__mark`. | | `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.test.tsx` | change | One new jsdom test. | | `e2e/cypress/component/lobby-screen.cy.tsx` | change | New measuring tests; the existing ones are untouched. | | `spec/rulings/R3954000.md` | new | The ruling note. | | `spec/pending/3954.md` | new | The §11 paragraph. | | `spec/rulings/R3730001.md` | change | Append one "Amended by [[R3954000]]" line. | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, any `crates/`, `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. The governing notes are R3730000 to R3730006 and R3731000 (the lobby), and R3728000 to R3728002 (the shell and its tab bar). ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx`, `YourDeck`.** - Add `import { createPortal } from "react-dom";` with the other imports. - Add the prop `readySlot: HTMLElement | null` to the props type and the destructuring. - In the return, move the whole Ready `

The "Ready to queue" mark has a space after it. - **Rejected:** compact seats on narrow or short windows, because they do not fit four seats plus the settings on a phone. A fixed bar, because it ignores the shell's offset. - Client only; no Hearthstone rule is involved. 8. **`spec/pending/3954.md`.** One paragraph: `**[[R3954000]] … (issue #3954, 2026-11-15)**: …`, a one-paragraph restatement of the ruling, as `spec/pending/3950.md` reads. 9. **`spec/rulings/R3730001.md`.** Append the line `Amended by [[R3954000]] (issue #3954): Ready sits in the lobby's action bar.` ## Tests - `cargo jackioh spec check`. - `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/lobby/LobbyScreen.test.tsx src/lobby/LobbyPanel.test.tsx src/routes/play.test.tsx`. The new tests must fail before step 3 (Ready is below the fold on the 2v2 and co-op phone) and pass after. - `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`. - Finally the harness's checks, including `cargo fmt --check` and the web tests. ## Done when - [ ] Ready, Leave and (for the host) Start are in view, above the tab bar, at all 7 sizes in 1v1, co-op and 2v2 (new cypress loop green). - [ ] The Verdict's ✓ has a gap before "Ready to queue" (new cypress test and CSS). - [ ] The existing lobby tests (jsdom and cypress) still pass. - [ ] Ruling R3954000, its pending paragraph and its tests are in place, and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green. - [ ] Typecheck, eslint and the harness's checks are green. - [ ] A decisions note says: sticky bar chosen over compact seats; Ready portaled rather than its state lifted; `DeckEditor.tsx` left alone because it draws no mark. ## Risks - **Portal timing.** Ready renders one commit after `YourDeck` mounts, once the slot ref's state is set. Existing tests use `findByTestId`, so this is safe. Do not use `getByTestId` right after `show()` in new tests. - **Slot while a visitor views.** The slot is only drawn for members. The `YourDeck` gate is the same `member` condition, so no Ready appears without a slot. - **Sticky breaks if an ancestor sets `overflow`.** None does today. If cypress shows the bar not sticking, look for a new `overflow` on `.lobby-screen` or `.menu-shell__main`; do not add one. - **Bar overlaps content.** The bar covers the seat bottoms until the page's end. That is intended and has an opaque background. - **Focus order.** Ready is now after the seats and invites in Tab order, matching its place on screen. - **Rule 7 and purity.** Web only. No engine, wire or config constant changes; `padding` and `gap` use design tokens. - **Existing cypress tests.** They mount without the shell, so `--shell-bottom` falls back to `0px`. Do not wrap them in the shell. ## Open questions - None that need a person. Optional: whether Ready should be `button-primary` when unready, to read as the one primary action. This plan leaves its current `button-secondary` class, since the issue does not ask for it. ````
